knowledge_point.title: Applying Row Operations To an Augmented Matrix

question.:question/problem:
Consider the augmented matrix $A,$ given by

$$
A=\left[\begin{array}{cc|c}4 & -1 & 9 \\ 6 & 5 & -6 \\ -1 & -9 & 1\end{array}\right].
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation $R_{1}\leftrightarrow R_{2}$ on $A?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The operation $R_{1}\leftrightarrow R_{2}$ means that we need to swap the first and second rows.

Applying this row operation, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}A &= \left[\begin{array}{cc|c}4 & -1 & 9 \\ 6 & 5 & -6 \\ -1 & -9 & 1\end{array}\right]\,R_{1}\leftrightarrow R_{2} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{cc|c}6 & 5 & -6 \\ 4 & -1 & 9 \\ -1 & -9 & 1\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$

What matrix results from carrying out the row operation $R_{3}:=-\frac{1}{3}R_{3}$ on $A?$
question.:question/worked-solution:
The operation $R_{3}:=-\frac{1}{3}R_{3}$ means that we need to multiply the third row of the matrix by $-\frac{1}{3}.$

Multiplying the $3$rd row by $-\frac{1}{3}$, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}A &= \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 3 & 8 & -1 \\ 7 & 1 & -9 & 4 \\ 6 & -3 & 9 & 0\end{array}\right]\,R_{3}:=-\frac{1}{3}R_{3} \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 3 & 8 & -1 \\ 7 & 1 & -9 & 4 \\ -\frac{1}{3}\cdot 6 & -\frac{1}{3}\cdot (-3) & -\frac{1}{3}\cdot 9 & -\frac{1}{3}\cdot 0\end{array}\right] \\ &\sim \left[\begin{array}{ccc|c}1 & 3 & 8 & -1 \\ 7 & 1 & -9 & 4 \\ -2 & 1 & -3 & 0\end{array}\right]\end{aligned}
$$
